steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Hella! Please stop! You're hurt, your body—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can keep going, I can still...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, heal already... damn it... I'm supposed to be the top Sinner, right?... Isn't this power supposed to kick in right now, when I need it most?
(Scene change)

Amidst fierce combat, shackles pierce from within her. Horo acutely feels the Black Ring's influence. She bravely protects those escaping, but slowly, she too is affected, stirring up emotions long buried deep within.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Huff... Huff... This is the Black Ring... This is what they were up against that day...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...You vile creature! It wasn't enough to take our boss, my brother, and now you have the audacity to appear before me, slaughtering even more?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Go back to where you came from! I won't let you get away with this!!
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Crache!! Crache!!! Hold on, I'm here to help you!!!

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Ahhh...!!
The boy tumbles down, his gun useless in his defense. However, a set of rugged, mud-stained hands grasp him—those of the very gloomy man he had just had a big argument with.
He looks panicked and annoyed, almost as if he can't understand his own actions. But the backpack on the man's back comes undone, scattering flyers everywhere.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Ha... Why did I even come back? Must be losing my mind, likely caught Mania, won't last much longer... and here I am, rescuing people like you...

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Hahahaha... I've spent my whole life playing it safe to stay alive, but now that death is near, it's oddly freeing... I want to do something heroic!

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: ...My last act something to remember... Hang tough, kiddo—
Crache extends her hand, and with the final trace of shadow departing from her, she propels those two onto a different floor.

As the final sliver of the sun sinks beneath the horizon, the shadows dissolve into the night. With no support left, Crache plummets downwards, a myriad of leaflets cascading around her, brushing past her hands.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's those sappy poems again...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What's written... up there...?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's too dark... I can't see it...
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: It's been quite a while, and I've had more than my fair share of obstacles.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Still, it's great to see you again, Bai. It reminds me of the day we met; I stumbled upon you and brought you home.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Are you with me again? The ones you turned your back on have mostly paid the ultimate price. Here's your second chance.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Or is it that you really hate me so much?
She pauses before a thicket of deep red crystalline spikes, amidst which lies a woman with a ponytailed hairdo.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hate? Ha... No way... My life is too valuable to squander on feelings like that...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: If you hadn't shown up to wreck my place, I'd have been content to live and let live.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: ...This is what you call home?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: How can it not be? I got hotpot, good booze, a pushover I can borrow from without paying back, and these gullible employees I can mess with.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: On the Overground, everyone looks out for themselves, guarding their tiny slice of the world, maybe a few close pals... That's just more my style.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'm just a small fry, not cut out for your lofty ambitions. This spot's good enough for me; I'm fine meeting my end right here.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: But if I'm going down, I'll take you with me.
The old lady lets out a knowing laugh. The woman who doggedly exposes the charade of the Underground Shepherd and pilfers the White Cube from her—she's anything but a "small fry."
Seems they've had their share of fun like this in the past, Bai being way lazier back then compared to the one standing before her now.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: I've never heard you speak like this before. Looks like you've finally found something to live for, which I find comforting.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: At heart, you're still one of our own from the Underground. I'll have your old mates see you through this part of the trip.
The old lady moves off without a second look back. And from the earth she has just walked upon, familiar, mud-soaked shapes begin to rise, creeping up slowly.
The man is long gone, his mind dissolved into the void. But his body is dedicated to Mania, becoming its vessel to rejoin the Black Ring, just as the initial contract stipulates.
(Scene change)

A flood of minds from the Black Ring infiltrates your thoughts, stirring turmoil and a profound heaviness. You're paralyzed, unable to open your eyes, but you dimly perceive someone bearing your body forward, whispering under their breath as they go.
This feels like déjà vu, like just before you nearly met your end last time.
I'll... take you away...
Silence answers you, while those deep, muddled murmurs persist, leading you somewhere unknown.
You try to open your eyes, to wrestle back control and understand what is happening. You fight hard to pierce through the engulfing darkness.
—Just then, you spot a speck of blue light, and with it comes a voice, strange yet somewhat recognizable.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: ...Hmm? How did I end up here?

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Hmm... Looks like things have only gone downhill in the months I've been gone.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: But with you around, we'll find a solution, no doubt.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Alright, take a deep breath, focus on what's important to you.
A cocoon of white light gradually wraps around you. You spot a few indistinct figures and try to hold onto them, your awareness wavering and slowly taking shape.
Then, the apparitions merge into a thin, unknown woman.
As you come to, the woman offers a faint smile.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Nice to meet you, ${PlayerName}... or is it more apt to say... long time no see.
Her face is a mystery to you, but something about her feels oddly familiar.
It's a strange kind of familiarity, the kind where you know deep down, asking won't shed any light.

You actually don't recall her identity. The first time you see her, a sense of caution and alertness rises in you. But at the same time, there is a peculiar feeling of familiarity, prompting you to speak before your mind can process it.
...Long time no see.
